historical_reviews.deepseek: The exact read is a useful primitive but does not establish the standby state or physical mapping; SDR is truncated, credentials are exposed and IB/Sensor List/Web are incomplete.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly requires an approved standby definition and passive state proof while prohibiting power-state changes, driver reloads, BMC writes and default log clearing.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-36 requires physical/electrical meaning; ED-38 makes `(NVGPU)` non-executable, reserves the verdict and prohibits state-changing preparation.

original_test_intent: Validate the PWR_STBY_HSC standby hot-swap-controller power reading and identity against the approved standby-power specification across the management views available in the owner-defined standby state.
original_method: The power owner defines what standby means for this platform, the energized auxiliary rail and protected load, HSC/NVGPU association and expected interface availability; automation observes the already-established state without causing a transition.
manual_activity: The platform/power owner defines and establishes the standby condition outside agent control, approves the auxiliary-rail/HSC/load mapping, expected IB/OOB/Web availability and limits, then issues the verdict.
required_inputs: Exact standby state such as host S5, DC-off with AC present, BMC-only, or another platform state
Who establishes the state and passive proof that it is stable before collection
PWR_STBY_HSC physical HSC, auxiliary input rail/feed, protected load and NVGPU association
Expected IB, OOB and Web availability in that state and treatment of an unavailable IB path
Power quantity, units, scale, sign, aggregation window, refresh and unavailable semantics
Allowed range and power-good/fault criteria for the exact state and configuration
Secret-safe OOB/Web collectors and independent power recovery
safety_requirements: Do not enter, exit or cycle the standby state; observe only a condition established by the owner
Treat `(NVGPU)` as annotation and run no GPU command or workload
Do not require IB output if the approved standby state makes host execution impossible; record expected unavailability
Do not change HSC, power, load, driver, threshold, BMC or log state
Stop on unexpected state transition, rail/fault change, stale data, identity mismatch or incomplete expected evidence
Use independent recovery if the platform leaves the approved power state
agent_execution_scope: Verify unique source identity and approved standby-state package
Verify HSC/aux-rail/load/NVGPU mapping and same-target identity read-only
Collect complete views that are approved as available, exact sensor evidence and BMC Web
Compare value/state/freshness with passive rail/power-good/SEL evidence
Perform no state transition, workload, driver action, power control, mutation, retry or verdict
engineer_actions: Define standby state, entry owner and expected interface availability
Define power semantics and state-specific limits
Review evidence and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Partially useful for an OOB exact read, but it neither proves standby state nor satisfies complete available-view/Web evidence; SDR is truncated and credentials are exposed. In-band execution may be impossible in the true target state.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After owner establishes and proves the approved standby state, collect complete secret-safe OOB and Web evidence and only the interfaces explicitly expected to remain available; preserve passive rail/fault context.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Exact PWR_STBY_HSC identity, specified views and 3/3-minute estimates remain, subject to the owner-defined standby interface matrix.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Represent the case as a state-qualified observation: prove the power state, record which execution planes should exist, query the exact channel through those planes, and compare against state-specific electrical limits.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Avoids trying to satisfy an in-band command requirement when the host is intentionally off and prevents the agent from changing power state merely to obtain evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: An on-state reading or an OOB value without standby proof does not validate standby HSC power.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Standby is ambiguous across ACPI, chassis and board power domains; an apparently valid cached BMC reading may predate the state transition unless freshness is proven.

project_override_considerations: If the approved state has no IB path, OOB/Web plus explicit IB-unavailable evidence can satisfy the method only after owner approval; a live host shell is not proof of the target standby condition.
expected_evidence: Approved standby definition, entry responsibility and stable state proof
Expected interface matrix and explanation for any unavailable IB path
Exact reading/state/unit/scale/freshness plus passive power-good/fault context and state-specific limits
Complete redacted available SDR/Sensor List evidence and BMC Web with same-target proof

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently names one standby HSC power channel. Ambiguity is in the undefined standby condition and interface expectations, not contradictory source identities.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The state-qualified passive observation is identifiable after the owner supplies standby semantics, topology and criteria under ED-36.

review_improvement: Makes state proof and interface availability first-class acceptance inputs, preventing both an unintended power transition and a false failure caused by demanding IB access from an off host.
independent_technical_reasoning: A standby power sensor is meaningful only relative to a precisely defined chassis/ACPI/rail state. Since the BMC may remain alive while the host and in-band IPMI path do not, collection completeness must be judged against the approved state matrix, and cached telemetry must be excluded through freshness evidence.
